crossRefs.note: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

translations.web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
translations.bsb: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
translations.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded
translations.asv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
